Description
Welcome to the Mackenzie Green, these low-rise Vancouver townhomes were built in 2012 by Pantheon Developments Ltd. The location and the neighbouring community of Mackenzie Heights is a top notch. Exclusive collection of boutique Townhomes features include Inform European custom cabinets, Wolf stainless gas range, Integrated appliances, wide-plank engineered walnut flooring, Quartzite countertops, overheight ceilings, frameless glass shower enclosures, contemporary bathrooms, and high-ceiling spacious bedrooms. The ground floor also has an exclusive outdoor patio and the indoor has an office den area and a in-suite storage. This home is perfect for a small family. 1 parking is included in the rent, utilities are not included. This home does not have AC.

Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Beautifully updated, unfurnished 2-story townhouse-style condo in sought-after Kitsilano. This bright, south-facing home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a private fenced yard and patio, spacious laundry room and ample storage. Modern kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances and gas stove. Open-concept living and dining area with a cozy electric fireplace. Gas and in-floor heating included, plus 2 portable AC units and 1 underground parking stall. Building amenities include rooftop access, children's playroom, secure bike storage and workshop. Steps to transit, shops, cafes and restaurants. Close to UBC, Downtown, Bayview Elementary and parks. Pets allowed. Minimum 1-year lease.
